from pathlib import Path
import json,re

event_id="1791189585-ea654fefcb58"
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
raw=None
where=None
for d in ("sent","inflight","outbox"):
    p=base/d/f"{event_id}.json"
    if p.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"))
        raw=str(obj.get("message") or "")
        where=str(p)
        break

if raw is None:
    print("DIFFERENT_PATHS=EVENT_MISSING")
    raise SystemExit(42)

m=re.search(r'\|\| different=(\[[^\n]*?\])\s*\|\| FILE=', raw)
if not m:
    print("DIFFERENT_PATHS=LIST_NOT_FOUND || FILE="+where)
    raise SystemExit(42)

try:
    paths=json.loads(m.group(1))
except Exception as exc:
    print("DIFFERENT_PATHS=JSON_PARSE_FAIL || ERROR="+str(exc)[:180]+" || FILE="+where)
    raise SystemExit(42)

print("DIFFERENT_PATHS="+json.dumps(paths,separators=(",",":"))+" || COUNT="+str(len(paths))+" || FILE="+where,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(42)
